column3: “To me” replaces in me; when corrected interprets upon my reproof.
“Wealth” replaces wine; as his own is supplied.
“Makes himself rich” interprets making himself heavy with pledges.
“The people” is singular instead of peoples.
“Builds his house” supplies building where the text says gaining for his house.
“Forfeiting your life” interprets sinning against your soul.
“Stones” and “rafters” pluralize the singular stone and timber.
“Neighbors” pluralizes neighbor; pouring from the wineskin renders adding your wrath.
“Or” replaces the sequence of image descriptions.
